VBO:0200191.summary: Energetic and attentive to their people, Boradors often enjoy a job to do as well as close companionship. They can be keen learners and vocal watchdogs, though an individual’s temperament varies. This Labrador Retriever–Border Collie cross varies in size and coat, with no single fixed look.
VBO:0200191.shortDescription: An energetic Labrador–Border Collie cross, often attentive to its people, keen to learn and vocal about visitors.
